headword: {化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}

definitions.explanation: Natural fuels such as coal, oil, and natural gas, formed from the remains of ancient organisms. A key term in environmental and energy discussions.

examples.japanese: {化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}の{使用|しよう}を{減|へ}らすべきだ。
examples.english: We should reduce the use of fossil fuels.

examples.japanese: {化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}に{頼|たよ}らないエネルギーが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need energy that doesn't rely on fossil fuels.

examples.japanese: {化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}を{燃|も}やすと{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}が{排出|はいしゅつ}され、{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}の{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: Burning fossil fuels produces carbon dioxide, which causes global warming.

notes: A compound of {化石|かせき} (fossil) and {燃料|ねんりょう} (fuel). Includes {石炭|せきたん} (coal), {石油|せきゆ} (petroleum/oil), and {天然|てんねん}ガス (natural gas). Frequently used in discussions about {環境問題|かんきょうもんだい} (environmental issues) and {再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギー (renewable energy). Common collocations include {化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}からの{脱却|だっきゃく} (breaking away from fossil fuels) and {化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}への{依存|いぞん} (dependence on fossil fuels).
